messages:
nina_cs: FYI - HeliosData asked for early renewal and to move from quarterly to annual billing with a 15% volume discount. Current ARR $95k. They want it done this week. Need legal + finance signoff.

omar_sales: spoke to buyer: they want 15% only if we include 2 support hours/month and a 30-day onboarding guarantee. CFO will sign if vendor code provided.

claire_legal: need to see the exact support language. If we commit hours, add SLA appendix and cap liability. I'll draft a short addendum. ETA EOD.

frank_fin: Finance needs vendor code HD-444 and prefers Net30. Quarterly->annual change needs updated billing schedule. Also confirm if support hours are billable or included.

ash_enable: Enablement can provide a 60-min onboarding and a playbook. If support hours are included, we need a monthly triage contact and SLO expectations.

sid_se: SE: account health OK but noticed API error spikes last week. Recommend we add a small contingency in the onboarding to verify rate limits and caching.

nina_cs: Action list: @claire_legal draft addendum; @frank_fin confirm vendor code and billing; @omar_sales confirm whether support hours are paid or part of concession; @ash_enable prep playbook.

claire_legal: Drafted addendum with SLA appendix and a clause: "two included support hours per month, unused hours do not roll over; additional hours billed at standard rate unless otherwise agreed." Uploading: https://drive.company/helios_addendum_v1

frank_fin: vendor code HD-444 confirmed. We'll accept annual billing and Net30. Note: if discount >12% we need VP Finance approval.

omar_sales: Buyer agreed to 12% not 15% and accepts included 2 support hours/month. I'll take final signoff from sales leadership.

claire_legal: Updated addendum to 12% and included onboarding guarantee language. PTAL.

omar_sales: Sending DocuSign now -> https://docusign.company/helios_xyz (signers: CFO, procurement). Adding @nina_cs as cc.

nina_cs: Logged renewal in Gainsight and set reminder: follow-up if not signed in 4 business days.

billing_bot: DocuSign envelope status: completed at 5999993355. PO HD-444 attached; invoice terms Net30.

ash_enable: Onboarding scheduled Apr 14 11:00 PT. Playbook and checklist shared. Will send a 3-question feedback pulse after week 2.

sid_se: I'll join the onboarding and run quick perf checks.

nina_cs: Closing loop: contract signed, PO in, onboarding scheduled. Will report feedback results after pulse
